notes: Heavily artifact-driven course: the dominant pattern is SSi USE/BUILD decoration drift — the SAME Tamil sentence glossed once plain and once with a trailing now/today/again/more/slowly that has no Tamil counterpart, or with a dropped is/are/it/I (48 of these = real_consolidate, all low/med, none high-frequency). Most single-word flags (61) are agglutinative roots sliced as 'component' inside larger LEGOs (only one drilled lego/build form each) so they're not learner-facing. A small recurring med-severity thread is inconsistent glossing of the desire verb விரும்புகிறேன் (want vs I'd like) and the modal வேண்டும் (have to/need to/should) across drilled phrases — worth a single course-wide policy. 4 genuine data errors (மாலை→afternoon, நமது→good, முக்கியம்→good more, ஆங்கிலம் dropped to 'more'). No genuine one-prompt-two-meanings overloads and no release blockers.
